title: UI icons / Alignment — Optical balance

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete carousel wrapper capture, including source navigation

slide_intent: Judge an icon by its visual weight so neighboring symbols appear aligned even when their shapes have unequal mass.
strategic_value: Optically balanced IBM icons can form a steadier visual rhythm across interface rows without changing their recognizable shapes.
demonstration: Two thumbs-up icons flank a circular face icon. Blue bounding areas, crosshairs and center markers expose placement; a green check marks the left treatment and a pink cross rejects the right. The source carousel reads 2/2.
practical_value: Compare optical balance against mechanical centering before positioning an asymmetric icon beside a more symmetrical one.

content_islands.name: Accepted optical alignment
content_islands.spec: Place the left thumbs-up on its blue square and crosshair, with the green check beneath.

content_islands.name: Symmetric reference
content_islands.spec: Center the circular face icon on the middle crosshair to establish the shared row alignment.

content_islands.name: Rejected alignment
content_islands.spec: Place the right thumbs-up against the same horizontal guide, retaining its differing vertical placement and pink cross below.

content_islands.name: Source navigation
content_islands.spec: Retain the previous control, 2/2 counter and disabled next control in the gray strip below the artwork.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying Alignment text explains that optical centering makes icons align correctly when exported and used side by side, and that mechanical centering sometimes fails.
reference_purposes.Application: The image compares a visually balanced and rejected placement of the same asymmetric icon against a symmetrical reference.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The green-check and pink-cross examples distinguish the accepted and rejected alignment in this specific comparison; the source does not prescribe a universal pixel offset.

ingredient.name: Optical icon alignment
ingredient.role: Create consistent perceived alignment among differently shaped symbols.
ingredient.application: Visually center the icon where its weight is heaviest and check it beside neighboring symbols rather than relying only on bounding-box center.
ingredient.scope: IBM UI-icon usage guidance. The displayed adjustment is an example, not a fixed offset for all asymmetric icons.
